rules: all current-paper experiments run from the locked integration branch
novelty collision reopens the problem lock immediately
primary metrics and tolerances are frozen before medium/full runs
no numeric result is evidence until the committed probe or benchmark actually executes
native work units remain separate; no synthetic aggregate work score
full-reference equivalence is mandatory wherever equivalence is claimed
